def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Clean Price: remove $ , commas and convert to numeric
    df['Price'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Price'].astype(str).str.replace(r'[\$,]', '', regex=True).str.strip(), errors='coerce')
    # Clean Quantity to numeric
    df['Quantity'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Quantity'], errors='coerce')
    # Clean Region: normalize case variants and typos
    region_map = {
        'north': 'North',
        'nort': 'North',
        'south': 'South',
        'suoth': 'South',
        'east': 'East',
        'west': 'West',
        'wst': 'West'
    }
    # strip then lower for mapping
    orig_region = df['Region'].astype(str).str.strip()
    lower = orig_region.str.lower()
    df['Region'] = lower.map(region_map)
    # for any unmapped but allowed values, title-case them; otherwise keep original if not in map
    # lower.map already handles all allowed lowercased values, fillna for unexpected
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].fillna(orig_region)
    # ensure allowed values are properly capitalized (in case of other casing)
    allowed_proper = {'north': 'North', 'south': 'South', 'east': 'East', 'west': 'West'}
    mask = df['Region'].astype(str).str.lower().isin(allowed_proper)
    df.loc[mask, 'Region'] = df.loc[mask, 'Region'].astype(str).str.lower().map(allowed_proper)
    # Clean Date (coerce invalid dates)
    df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'], errors='coerce')
    # Recompute Revenue from Quantity * Price (cross-column fix)
    df['Revenue'] = df['Quantity'] * df['Price']
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Filter Electronics (case-insensitive, stripped)
    filt = df[df['Category'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'electronics']
    filt = filt.dropna(subset=['Region', 'Revenue'])
    # Drop missing group keys and only keep allowed regions
    allowed = ['North', 'South', 'East', 'West']
    filt = filt[filt['Region'].isin(allowed)]
    grouped = filt.groupby('Region')['Revenue'].sum()
    # Convert to dict with JSON-serializable types
    result = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items() if pd.notna(k)}
    return result
